page.overview:
What is Vakkian Wing?

The Vakkian Wing was a rumored starship with a cursed crew. In 3 ABY, a humanoid member of the Rokana Raiders invoked the Vakkian Wing while talking to fellow raider Niah as a reason to be concerned about the sounds they heard while guarding the Khepi Tomb.

The Vakkian Wing was mentioned in the "A Pirate's Fortune" expansion for Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws,
